result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but the 'Popular right now' section has a broken/failed image, and several elements are clipped at the right edge. Card treatments are inconsistent between the two popular listings.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card shows a grey broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, while the card below renders a full image.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading logic and add a branded fallback (e.g. cuisine illustration or logo) rather than an empty broken-image icon.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) button on the broken-image card uses a light grey circle with a white outline icon on an equally light grey background, making it nearly invisible; the same button on the pizza card is dark and clearly visible.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent, sufficiently contrasting button style (dark translucent circle) regardless of the underlying image state.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you' the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') and its image are hard-clipped by the viewport edge with the title cut mid-word and no ellipsis, so it is unclear the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek so the next card is partially visible by design, and truncate long titles with an ellipsis.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent peek of the next chip or add a fade/gradient edge to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, hiding its title, rating and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.
